title: Bakery and Orchard
author: Noor Galloway
blurb: Ines Amberdale, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
